done_when: The team sentence counts stories with no plan instead of naming them, and forge board --json fills the team's in-progress list from the same row states the page uses

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 1, Harm 1
Raise: Test. The in-progress proof compares only titles. It would still pass if `team.in_progress` contained the correct rows but reported their `stage` values instead of the page's `state` values. The fixture also has no ready-to-merge top-level row, so the test does not verify that named page state is included. The Done-when item requires the list to come from the same row states the page uses.
findings.title: Not done: tests/test_board_runway.py::test_8_below_the_fold

why: The board's team sentence names every story that has no plan, so on a larger team it runs to eight lines, and the board data leaves its in-progress list empty
